🎥🎬: Blade (1998)

Blade is a half-human, half-vampire warrior who spends his life hunting the creatures responsible for his mother’s death. Unlike ordinary vampires, he can walk in daylight while possessing their strength, speed, and heightened senses.

When the ambitious vampire Deacon Frost begins plotting to awaken the ancient blood god La Magra, Blade discovers that Frost’s plan could unleash a supernatural catastrophe. With the help of his mentor Whistler and hematologist Karen Jenson, Blade battles through the vampire underworld to stop him.

As Frost moves closer to completing the ritual, Blade must embrace everything that makes him different and fight to prevent the vampires from taking control of humanity.

source_details.synopsis: Blade is a 1998 American superhero film based on the Marvel Comics character. The first in the Blade film series, it was directed by Stephen Norrington and written by David S. Goyer. Wesley Snipes stars as Blade, a human with vampire strengths but not their weaknesses, who battles other vampires. The supporting cast includes Stephen Dorff, Kris Kristofferson and N'Bushe Wright. Blade was released by New Line Cinema in the United States on August 21, 1998, and was a commercial success, grossing $131 million on a budget of $45 million.
